sentences.en: He applied for a job with the Bank of Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 他向东京银行申请了一份工作。

sentences.en: Mother applied the medicine to the sore on my knee.
sentences.zh: 妈妈把药膏抹在了我的膝盖上的伤口上。

sentences.en: The proposed methodology is applied to three simulated case studies.
sentences.zh: 提议的方法被应用到了三个模拟案例研究中。

senses.zh: 应用；实施（apply的过去分词）；敷上
